label: mid/late original-phase steps (t=4-7) after e/0/q/y in early positions
explanation: Fires almost exclusively in the original-input phase at steps t=4-7 (99% of activations, 99.5% of mass; peak at t=5-6); never at t<=2, t>=8 or in the copy phase, rarely at the delimiter. The position window alone has precision only 0.18. Within it, firing is gated by prefix content: much more likely and stronger when original positions 1-2 contain e, 0, q or y (recent t also boosts). Top examples have several such tokens early (s e e e t, u y 0 q t). Requiring >=3 such prior tokens gives precision ~0.51 but low recall, suggesting a graded sum over the prefix rather than a crisp rule. Current input token matters little (lift <=1.6x); in_first=1 mildly enriched.
